newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish bond prices dip after US payroll jump.
newsitem.headline: Danish bond prices dip after US payroll jump.

text.p: Danish bond prices followed U.S. treasuries down on Friday after higher than expected American employment figures.
At 1545 GMT the benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 traded at 109.44, yielding 6.59 percent, down 0.26 point from Thursday's close, in turnover of 4.3 billion crowns.
Its March future, however, rose 0.06 point to 108.70, with 53 contracts traded.
The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 gained 0.30 point to 86.75. The crown continued to firm, to 3.8077 per mark from 3.8090 at midday.
The 10-year yield gap with Germany widened two basis points to 68 bp. --Steve Weizman, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969650
